hints.title: Sequential Index Scan
hints.text: Traverse the array from index 0 upward to ensure the smallest matching index is found first.

hints.title: Digit Sum Extraction
hints.text: Extract decimal digits using modulo 10 arithmetic to compute each element sum.

hints.title: Early Return
hints.text: As soon as digit sum equals the current index i, return i immediately, or return -1 if no match occurs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: log10(M) is at most 10 for standard 32-bit integers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning backwards would not directly identify the smallest matching index.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place digit extraction uses constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write clean digit sum extraction without unnecessary memory allocation.
